units.source_text: 古歌：“初秋风雨暴，山里复如何？

en.t: An old poem says: "In early autumn, wind and rain rage; how must it be in the mountain village?

units.source_text: 遥想山居者，青襟泪亦多。”见《新千载集》。

en.t: I imagine the one living in the mountains; tears must be wetting his blue robe as well." This appears in the New Collection of a Thousand Years.
